description: Dated, cited grid developments (moratoria, tariffs, queue reforms, large builds) across markets. An announcement is not delivery; each row says its stage. Rows sharing an event_id are one real-world event: do not count them twice or sum their MW. Optionally filter to one market. Responses from API schema 1.1 onward also carry figures.{field} = {value, unit, as_of (ISO date or month), source, method, confidence, stable_id, report_url}: when present, quote the unit and as_of from it, and a null value there carries figures.{field}.absence -- insufficient_evidence (not enough evidence), structurally_unavailable (does not exist there, e.g. no wholesale market), not_collected (exists, not held) or withheld (paid) -- with reason_text; report which one. Older responses have no figures object: take the unit from the field name or field_provenance and the date from as_of. Either way, never report an absent value as zero; say it is not held.

market.description: Market id (public slug), e.g. 'ontario', 'ercot', 'ireland'. Use pgiq_markets to list ids.
